name: First Step Of Summoning
description:
New Summoner!
You mustn't neglect the basics!
I'll show you the ropes!
Client: Mysterious Old Man

name: Knowledge Of Armour
description:
You new adventurers don't make it easy to look after you.
The Guild will help you at first,
so get some decent equipment before you set out!
Client: Guild Master Ganan

name: Reigrad Branch
description:
Dreaming and longing doesn't do anything.
You have to complete the job first.
We'll talk again after that!
Client: Guild Master Ganan
Area: Isliid Empire
Quest: Agrana Volcano "The Journey Begins"

name: Exterminating Gobuls
description:
Eliminate the Gobuls in the Agrana Volcano. Working for the sake of people and for the world is an adventurer's first duty!
Client: Guild Master Ganan
Area: Isliid Empire
Dungeon: Agrana Volcano

name: Rumours Volcano
description:
I found a good source of 'Fire Ore'.
I'd like to get it before the rumours spread.
Will you help me?
Client: Mash

name: The Girl's Feelings
description:
I heard there's a wonderful soup dish on the Ribnald Snow Field. I'll share it with anyone who helps me.
Client: Sylphy

name: Forest Production
description:
You'll find Earth Ore in the forest. Do you know where you can find it? Thanks again.
Client: Mash

name: The Miraculous Guardian
description:
Surveying ruins is romance to an adventurer. You'll die if you get too ahead of yourself, though. Why? ...Because there are traps everywhere!
Client: Guild Master Ganan
Area: Isliid Empire
Dungeon: Ruins of Selunia

name: A Mysterious Light
description:
Apparently everyone collecting Dark Ore was defeated in battle, and their loot went everywhere. There's only one thing for us to do, right?
Client: Mash

name: Fight, Adventurer!
description:
Do you always fight alone? Sometimes competing, sometimes cooperating. That's also part of being an adventurer!
Client: Guild Master Ganan

name: A Knight's Feelings 1
description:
Why did they appear at such a busy time? They'd be fish in a barrel for us usually. If only I was in good health...
Client:  Ribald
Area: Isliid Empire
Quest: Ribnald Snow Field

name: A Knight's Feelings 2
description:
Being a proud soldier in the Isliid Empire's army isn't something we'd usually ask adventurers to do. However, that and people's safety are two different things...
Client: Ribald
Area: Isliid Empire
Quest: Fort Goldoa

name: Dawn Of A Young Adventurer
description:
I hate being weak! I want to fight and get stronger! But I need to prepare to be able to.
Client: Lute

name: Dawn Of A Young Cook
description:
Become an adventurer... Why should I go and put myself in danger? I have to sort myself out!
Client: Sylphy

name: In The Footsteps Of Heroes
description:
New Summoners, don't get comfortable just yet! Your lack of ambition is pathetic... I'll help you out just this once!
Client: Mysterious Old Man

name: Don't Underestimate Poison
requirement_description: Enhance A Ring Of Poison To Lv3
description:
Are you safe from poison? Poison can really hurt you if you underestimate it. Be prepared!
Client: Guild Master Ganan

name: A Gift At The Coast
description:
You went all the way to the coast? Why didn't you tell me? I thought we were friends! I expect a souvenir next time.
Client: Mash

name: Monster On The Promenade
description:
I was thinking about going to Coroc Road sometime soon... But it seems dangerous with the high numbers of Corocs recently.
Client: Albert
Area: Republic of Gramenia
Dungeon: "Coroc Road"

name: An Invigorating Stone
description:
I just can't seem to cheer up... Aren't there any items that can make me feel better by looking at them? Ooh, like a Light Ore!
Client: Mash

name: Items To Remove A Curse
description:
"Black Mushrooms" from Loguno Marsh are necessities for us priests. Holy water can't break curses on its own.
Client: Andrei

name: Ganan's Troubles
description:
We have a request from the Royal Knights. They want us to defeat a Wyvern. I'm looking for someone who can go immediately!
Client: Guild Master Ganan
Area: West Famelle
Dungeon: Magic Cave of Valdan

name: Knowledge Of Adventurers
description:
If you're with me, brother, I won't be scared on any adventure I go on! Let's go on our next adventure right now!
Client: Lute
Area: Isliid Empire
Quest: Plains of Isliid 
"The Little Adventurer"

name: The Merchant 1
description:
Demand and supply is interesting, isn't it? You never have a supply of things when you need them... But that's when it's time for me to make some money.
Client: Mash

name: The Girl's Debt
description:
Grandpa, Grandma. Thank you for everything. Can I do anything for you?
Client: Sylphy

name: The Knight's Stubbornness
description:
I'm just a Knight of the Kingdom of Famelle... But I have to defeat the Dark Beast Gillius! Please lend me your strength!
Client: Raymond
Area: West Famelle
Dungeon: Famelle Rock

name: A Cowardly Knight
description:
I could complete this mission easily on my own, of course. But I'm a cautious man. Would you accompany me? ...You're not scared of ghosts, are you?
Client: Raymond
Area: West Famelle
Dungeon: Ghost Ship

name: Time Waits For No Man
description:
It's nice to be able to travel leisurely, but time waits for no man in this world. Adventurer, know that time speed is essential!
Client: Guild Master Ganan

name: Making Alcohol is Risky
description:
Drinking too much shortens your life. But the people who make alcohol are deadly serious about it, too! I don't want to sleep when the birds are just waking...
Client: Dan

name: A Growing Knight
description:
There are time when a Knight of the Kingdom of Famelle must dive into the dead ground. But I am reassured to have you by my side.
Client: Raymond
Area: West Famelle
Dungeon: Magic Cave of Valdan

name: On The Road Again 1
description:
Coroc Road...
I want to take someone there. I hope everything goes well.
Client: Albert
Area: Republic of Gramenia
Quest: Coroc Road "On The Road Again"

name: On The Road Again 2
requirement_description: Clear "The Ecosystem of the Road" 1 Time
description:
Coroc Road...
I want to take someone there. I hope everything goes well.
Client: Albert
Area: Republic of Gramenia
Quest: Coroc Road 
"The Ecosystem of the Road"

name: On The Road Again 3
requirement_description: Clear "The End of the Road" 1 Time
description:
Coroc Road...
I want to take someone there. I hope everything goes well.
Client: Albert
Area: Republic of Gramenia
Quest: Coroc Road 
"The End of the Road"

name: The Merchant 2
description:
I'm looking for Fire Crystals at the moment.
I often judge people based on how they react to such sudden requests.
Client: Mash

name: Stop The Giant Weapon!
description:
We have a request from the Royal Knights. They want us to defeat "Mecha Vaido". I'm looking for someone who can go immediately!
Client: Guild Master Ganan
Area: East Famelle
Quest: Nomoris Underground Lake 
"The Master of Nomoris"

name: Master Of The Inn 1
description:
I have a request for you, Ganan.
I need this for my shop,
and it's not a bad deal for you too, right?
Client: Gloria

name: I'm A Girl, Too
description:
I word hard day in, day out.
Sometimes I want a bit of relaxation. Something sweet wouldn't hurt, would it?
Client: Liese

name: A Hero's Limit?
description:
Limit, you say?
What kind of half-baked summoner are you?
Do this, and you're sorted!
Client: Mysterious Old Man

name: Equipment Isn't Just A Tool
requirement_description: Limit Break A Piece Of Equipment
description:
You're finally shaping up to be an adventurer.
But you still don't understand some of the basics.
Here, take this.
Client: Guild Master Ganan

name: A Knight's False Pride
description:
Never falter, break or yield.
That's what it means to be a Royal Knight!
But... No one said anything about asking for help. Please accompany me.
Client: Raymond
Area: East Famelle
Dungeon: Moguro Sand Sea

name: Preparedness Stops Tears
description:
Adventurers always work alone, with no insurance... You have to be prepared at all times, but preparing for the unlikely is an iron-clad rule for adventurers.
Client: Guild Master Ganan

name: Adventurer-The Good Customer
description:
You've begun journeying quite far now.
If you've gone that far, perhaps you've
come across some "Earth Crystals"?
Client: Mash

name: The Knight's Promotion
description:
I’ve been tasked to explore the ruins of the gods... This is a true honor for a Knight of the Kingdom of Famelle. Care to share this honor with me?
Client: Raymond
Area: East Famelle
Dungeon: Ancient Ruins of Lerocque

name: A Little Won't Show
description:
There are rumours that "Dark Crystals"
are being stored in the Sorcerous Fort. Could you go fetch some for me?
Client: Mash

name: Soldier Of The People 1
description:
The monsters are enraged... What's going on?
There's no time to lose!
Peoples' livelihoods are at stake here!
Client: Ribalt
Area: Sealed Fortress Gormarey
Quest: Ogrone Volcano 
"Bursting Magma"

name: Soldier Of The People 2
description:
Another mission to defeat monsters, with no time to rest!
I can't be seen to back down now!
Please lend me your strength!
Client: Ribalt
Area: Sealed Fortress Gormarey
Quest: Demon Fortress Gormarey
"Storming the Demon Castle"

name: Master Of The Inn 2
description:
Ganan, this young man of yours
might be quite reliable in the future.
I've got something else you can help the shop with.
Client: Gloria

name: The Secret Arts
description:
Our daily research never ends...
Not until our objective has been fulfilled.
That reminds me though, I could ask him to help me.
Client: Rem

name: Courage And Mercantilism
description:
To think you've actually gone as far as Ogrone Volcano...
Your courage astounds me!
So... How many "Fire Crystals" did you find?
Client: Mash

name: Rather Than Sleeping
description:
It's wrong to take things from the temple, you say?
I'm sure the "Water Crystals" would
much rather be used than sit there collecting dust.
Client: Mash

name: Incompatible Existence
description:
Adventurers and thieves are like oil and water.
No one can forgive the things a thief does.
If you see one, show it who's boss!
Client: Guild Master Ganan
Area: Sealed Fortress Gormarey
Dungeon: Egol The Tree Sea

name: Another Type Of Crystal
description:
I'm missing one... Just one more kind...
You know what I'm talking about, don't you?
That's right. Bring me some "Light Crystals"
Client: Mash

name: Slay The Demonic Dragon!
description:
It will be a fierce battle...
But we must be victorious.
Don't say anything, just lend me your strength!
Client: Ribalt
Area: Sealed Fortress Gormarey
Dungeon: Black Gate

name: Challenging The Crimson King
description:
There's a Fire Dragon sleeping near the seal, huh?
It looks like you're ready.
I won't try to talk you out of it. Just come home safely.
Client: Guild Master Ganan
*Can only be completed by the creator of the Lobby.

name: Challenging The Withered Princess
description:
The feeling when you face the unknown.
That's what keeps driving you forward.
I believe in you.
Client: Guild Master Ganan
*Can only be completed by the creator of the Lobby.

name: Challenging The God Of Death
description:
I never thought anyone would be stupid enough to take themselves to visit the Reaper.
You just can't stop exploring, I guess.
Just don't die, you hear?
Client: Guild Master Ganan
*Can only be completed by the creator of the Lobby.

name: The Party Suddenly…
description:
Work just keeps coming in when you're busy, doesn't it?
I don't want to give in though...
I need your help.
Client: Sophie

name: Who To Ask In Hard Times
description:
A "Volcano Spirit Stone" huh?
They're very difficult to acquire.
Well... We could ask him to help.
Client: Giliam

name: Adventurer's Development 1
description:
I see... This quest is...
Hahaha, it's perfect!
I'll bring him out to play then, shall I?
Client: Guild Master Ganan
Area: Isliid Empire
Quest: Fort Goldoa 
"An Adventurer Grows Up"

name: Adventurer's Development 2
description:
I see... This quest is...
Hahaha, it's perfect!
I'll bring him out to play then, shall I?
Client: Guild Master Ganan
Area: Isliid Empire
Quest: Fort Goldoa 
"Various Rewards"

name: The Merchant 3
description:
My information network tells me that strange things
have been happening all over the world recently.
But a merchant has only one job in the end!
Client: Mash

name: Youth Adventure Group 1
description:
This is a nice place.
We've finally advanced to the city outskirts!
But there's something that worries me...
Client: Lute
Area: Isliid Empire
Quest: Plains of Isliid "Youth Adventure Group"

name: Youth Adventure Group 2
description:
This is a nice place.
We've finally advanced to the city outskirts!
But there's something that worries me...
Client: Lute
Area: Isliid Empire
Quest: Plains of Isliid "To The Secret Spot"

name: Youth Adventure Group 3
requirement_description: Clear "Danger Comes to the Plain" 1 Time
description:
This is a nice place.
We've finally advanced to the city outskirts!
But there's something that worries me...
Client: Lute
Area: Isliid Empire
Quest: Plains of Isliid "Shadow Over The Plains"

name: A Man Who Loves His City
description:
The city is sometimes threatened by monster attacks.
We can't wait for the knights to arrive...
I've got it! We can ask him for help!
Client: Albert
Area: Isliid Empire
Quest:Greenlay Forest
